page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m2.2xlarge is an x86_64 virtualization instance provisioned through KVM. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is configured at 16.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware vector support includes AVX and AVX-512F alongside cryptographic AES extensions, backed by a 33 MB L3 cache. The instance includes 0 GB of bundled local storage, necessitating remote block storage attachments, zero integrated GPUs, and a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate midrange compute capabilities across typical server tasks. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 5330.0 and a single-core score of 1413.0, paired with a PassMark CPU mark of 10387.28. In memory and caching tests, large-block uncached read and write throughput reached 56.89 GB/s and 40.25 GB/s respectively. Transactional execution is solid with Redis SET operations sustaining 7.82 million operations per second and static web serving delivering 9.01 GB/s. However, AI inference workloads exhibit limitations: text generation on a 7B parameter language model yields 7.92 tokens per second, categorizing it in lower performance tiers for larger transformer models.

Given its 1:2 compute-to-memory density, the instance offers balanced resource utilization for compute-oriented tasks without requiring excessive RAM allocation. Tradeoffs include modest network bandwidth and reliance entirely on network-attached storage. The hardware profile is appropriate for microservices, standard web serving, continuous integration builds, and entry-level transactional caching workloads that do not require heavy in-memory data structures.
